title: Darth Vader NOOOO
blurb: Darth Vader's NOOOOOOO — cinema's most operatic refusal, delivered by the galaxy's most dramatic man. The meme applications are endless because overreaction is the point: the wifi drops, the fries are cold, they killed off the good character. Channel the full theatrical devastation of a Sith lord into your smallest inconveniences. The Dark Side understands.
origin: Darth Vader's anguished cry from Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith / Return of the Jedi.
